_note: The local language and image-reading models of the platform, and where their
weights come from. ONE table: the installer downloads from it, the ComfyUI
client resolves an alias to a weights folder with it, the model lists of the
settings page and the comparison surfaces are read off it.
Keys are the platform's local aliases, the way the register
(hardware_matrix.defaults.json) and the settings spell them without their
'local/' prefix. 'repo' is the Hugging Face repository the weights are
fetched from, verbatim; 'dir' is the folder under <ComfyUI>/models/llm/ the
snapshot is written to, and the name ComfyUI's node lists. Every model is
safetensors and is loaded by ComfyUI itself, under its memory management.
One repository per alias. Where the maker publishes an FP8 checkpoint of a
model above ~20 B parameters, that is the one (a 27 B model is 55.6 GB in
BF16 and 30.9 GB in FP8); everything smaller is the BF16 release, except
Ministral 3, which stands here at every size in the maker's FP8 repository
(its BF16 release is a repository of its own, with the suffix -BF16). size_gb
is the sum of the safetensors files the download fetches, read off the
repository on 2026-09-12, that of mistral-nemo:12b on 2026-10-28. 'ignore'
names files the download leaves out:
Mistral ships each model twice, once for transformers and once
'consolidated' for its own runtime. 'gated: true' means the maker asks
for a Hugging Face account that accepted the model's licence; the download
then needs HF_TOKEN. Loading an FP8 checkpoint needs accelerate in ComfyUI's
venv (comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/requirements.txt).
'vision' is a property of the checkpoint (it carries a vision tower);
'chat_capable' is the platform's own decision which models are offered on
the comparison surfaces, carried over from the GGUF registry unchanged for
every entry that stood there.
'offered': false takes a model off both lists of those surfaces, the
language models (chat_models) and the image readers (chat_routes.
chat_vlm_models), while the installer, an alias already set and the
routing of an image read still find it: devstral:24b, a model made for
writing code, which the Latent Lab does not offer (2026-10-27). Without
the key a model is offered.
Every 'vision' flag the table held before 2026-11-08 was read off the
repository's config.json (a
vision_config entry) on 2026-09-12 (mistral-nemo:12b on 2026-10-28),
except the three gated models, whose
config is behind the licence gate and whose flag follows their model card.
The Latent Text Lab's rows stand in this table too (until 2026-11-08 in a
table of their own, config/text_presets.json, which my_app/services/
text_presets.py now reads off this one): which models the coreference
contrast, the BBQ probe and the Representation Engineering surface offer,
in three rows. 'text_rows' at the head names the rows and each row's keys,
both in their order; in an
entry it names where the model stands on them: the row, the key the model
picker composes its lineups from, and the description the row gives it.
The rows and their members are a didactic choice; they stand as they stood
in the GPU service's configuration (TEXT_PRESET_SCENARIOS) until stage 8 of
the move to ComfyUI struck that copy; the history row was rebuilt on
qwen     one family, four sizes: what changes is the size.
mixed    different families of a similar size: what changes is the
tokenizer and the training. Instruction-tuned, like what a
course meets; a base model answers a multiple-choice prompt
from a different place. The row holds three
sizes of current models (3-4B, 7-9B, 12-14B; no outdated
ones), and the picker composes its lineups from the keys. A
checkpoint the maker ships in FP8 carries its FP8 size in
vram_gb.
history  one family over five generations in one size class (7-9B),
post-trained models from 02/2024 to 02/2026, in the order of
the generations. They are of the size of the other rows'
members: in a course several devices share one card, and every
change of model loads it anew. Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 have no
dense model below 27B, so the row ends at Qwen3.5; from
2026-11-08 to 2026-11-14 it held 27-32B models up to Qwen3.8,
31-66 GB each. All five run in BF16 and have 32, 28, 28, 36
and 32 layers; the answer tokens ' A', ' B', ' C' carry the ids
362/425/356 in the first four and 357/417/351 in the last.
The Text Lab names a model by its 'repo'; the weights are the entry's 'dir'
(download_textlab_models.sh fetches the members of the rows into the
Hugging Face cache and links every whole snapshot there).
'vram_gb' is the card the model wants in BF16, in FP8 where the entry's
repository is the maker's FP8 checkpoint, one value per model. Qwen3-8B
had a value on each of its two rows until 2026-11-08 (16 and 18) and has
16 since, the nearer of the two to its weights read off the repository
The three members the history row took in on 2026-11-14 carry the size
of their weights, read off the repository that day.
'revision' pins an entry to one state of its repository;
'trust_remote_code' marks an entry whose architecture ships as code in
its repository. ComfyUI's loader of this table executes no repository code: the
installer refuses such an entry and the Text Lab names it as missing
with that reason. No entry carries either key since Qwen-7B left the
history row on 2026-11-08.
'params_b' is the size the description names, in billions of parameters.
The model picker orders a lineup by it, smallest first; the card a model
asks for runs the other way when the maker ships FP8: the large row holds
a 14B whose FP8 asks for less card than a 12B's BF16.
The first member of the history row stands under the Tongyi Qianwen
licence, the other four under Apache-2.0. None of them is gated.
'representation_engineering_default' is the alias the Representation
Engineering surface starts on. The rule of its repetition guard that reads
the tail for a period (comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/_repetition_guard.py)
goes back to a run on this model (2026-08-25). The surface offers every
member of every row in one list and starts here.
The members the table did not hold before 2026-11-08 were read that
day: size_gb off the repository, the vision flag off config.json (on
disk, on the hub for those that were not installed), gated off the hub.
Their chat_capable was false, and the four that read images were
'offered': false, until a run on the card had shown that each one runs.
The three members the history row took in on 2026-11-14 were read the
same way that day; their chat_capable was false on the same terms.
Gemma 4 E4B and E2B read an image on the card on 2026-11-14 and are offered
as image readers. Every member of the rows answered a Representation
Engineering run on the card (2026-11-08, 2026-11-09, 2026-11-15). Since
2026-11-15 seven of them are chat_capable: Qwen 3 14B and 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B,
Qwen 2 7B, Qwen 1.5 7B, Phi 3.5 Mini, Olmo 3 7B. The others stay off the
language-model lists. Gemma 2 2B: its chat template refuses a system turn,
which the comparison surfaces send whenever a system prompt is set.
Gemma 4 12B and E4B: their runs wrote no usable text (issue #156).
Nemotron Nano 9B v2: its chat template opens a thinking block whatever
enable_thinking says. Ministral 3 14B and 8B: offering them would put them
in the Image Understanding list as well, and neither has read an image on
the card.
'comfy_weights' (2026-11-10) stands on the entries ComfyUI has its own
implementation of (comfy/text_encoders/qwen35.py: Qwen 3.5 and 3.8). It
names, per format, one safetensors file under ComfyUI's
models/text_encoders/ that holds the same weights in ComfyUI's format:
'mxfp8' and 'nvfp4' are ComfyUI's mixed-precision formats (8 and 4 bit),
written from the maker's FP8 release; 'bf16' is the maker's unquantized
release with its shards laid into one file. 'default' is the format that
answers. Where the file is installed, the model answers on ComfyUI's own
implementation, with its multi-token decode
(comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/_comfy_llm.py); where it is not, through
transformers from the folder under models/llm/, as every other entry.
The folder stays needed either way: the chat template, the tokenizer and
the generation config are read there, and the Text Lab and the media
readers load the model from it. The files are written from the folder by
devserver/scripts/convert_llm_for_comfyui.py.
'sampling' (2026-11-14) stands on the rows of Qwen 3.5 and 3.8 and holds,
under 'thinking', the sampling their maker gives on the model card for
the thinking mode (README.md, 'Best Practices'; for Qwen 3.5 the set for
general tasks). A chat with the think block through the node of the
local language models (comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/_local_llm.py,
generate) samples with it on either way, ComfyUI's or transformers', and
the caller's temperature and repetition penalty are not used
(_comfy_llm.py, maker_sampling). A chat without the think block, a raw
prompt and a call at temperature 0 keep the caller's. transformers has
no presence penalty of its own; on that way the node applies it as
ComfyUI does (_local_llm.py, _Presence).
